about: What Figma does that the translation rests on. Each fact is checked (a primary source read or a probe run, with its date), derived (worked out from a documented API, not observed), believed or unchecked; a fact not checked names the check that settles it. Code that relies on one cites it as figma-fact:<id>; test-figma-facts.mjs holds every citation to an entry here. A fix's plan cites the facts its assumption rests on, under Claims.

facts.fact: A layer's rotation turns counter-clockwise on screen; CSS's rotate turns clockwise.
facts.source: developers.figma.com Plugin API, node rotation: rotation = atan2(-m10, m00) of the relative transform, with y down
facts.settles: draw a layer at rotation 30 through the bridge and read its corners' absolute positions

facts.fact: An instance cannot override the position, constraints or order of a layer inside its component.
facts.source: help.figma.com 'Apply changes to instances' (360039150733), "You can't override": "The order, or z-index, of any layers within the instance"; "Position of any layers within the component, including items in an auto layout frame"; "Any constraints applied to the layers"; "The bounds of any text layers"

facts.fact: An instance can override the size of a non-text layer inside its component.
facts.source: help.figma.com 'Apply changes to instances' (360039150733, read 2026-11-20) names only text layers' bounds as not overridable, and is silent on other layers
facts.settles: resize a nested rectangle in an instance through the bridge, then reset the main's size and read whether the instance keeps its own

facts.fact: An image fill's own rotation turns in the same direction as the layer's rotation.
facts.source: parity/adapt.mjs adds the two; its only test (180 + 180) cannot tell the direction
facts.settles: an image fill turned 90 on a layer turned 0, read against a render

facts.fact: An auto-layout frame that hugs its contents keeps the size it last had once it holds nothing.
facts.source: a source file's empty slot at 172 px, the size it had before it was emptied
facts.settles: empty a hugging frame through the bridge and read its size

facts.fact: An override set to a different value and back to the main's value is kept as an override.
facts.source: probe through the bridge on an icon button's instance (the round-trip plan's Phase 4b claims, 2026-11-17); no script kept

facts.fact: A component's root layer cannot be hidden by one of its own properties, so a prop that takes the whole component away is not drawn.
facts.source: a boolean property binds only to the visibility of layers inside the component (to-figma's drawing, 2026-11-13)
facts.settles: try to bind a boolean property to a component's own visible through the bridge

facts.fact: Figma's corner smoothing is not a superellipse, so CSS can only approximate it.
facts.source: figma.com/blog/desperately-seeking-squircles ('Desperately seeking squircles', read 2026-11-20): Figma built a parametrizable smoothing scheme after "the superellipse formula wasn't quite right" for Apple's shape; it never states outright that its smoothing is not a superellipse
facts.settles: export a smoothed corner's vector path through the bridge and fit it against a superellipse
